bio.jane/contract.noReading: DnaCauldron's spreadsheets and summary table, which the outputs carry; the assembly itself is read by golden_gate_assemble or gibson_assemble, and a report over their result adds no second verdict.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does DnaCauldron's assembly report say about this assembly result?

description: Build DnaCauldron's assembly report from an assembly result: the per-construct summary table, the constructs and errors spreadsheets as pandas-compatible CSV, and the Outcome / Number of assemblies stats. Wire `golden_gate_assemble` or `gibson_assemble`'s `products`, `errors` and `warnings` outputs into it.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

assembly_name.description: the name for this assembly: the `assembly_name` column of the summary table and the first field of every errors row.

enzyme.description: the Type-IIS enzyme, for a method that has one — it becomes the report's `enzymes` column, mirroring DnaCauldron's `Type2sRestrictionAssembly.get_extra_construct_data()`. Leave it empty for Gibson, which has no enzyme: an empty column would imply one exists.

errors.description: structured assembly errors — wire the assembly node's `errors` output. These become the errors spreadsheet, which is the most useful thing in a report about a run that did not work.

products.description: the enumerated constructs — wire an assembly node's `products` output. Each needs `id`, `sequence` and `fragmentNames`, which is what both assembly nodes emit.

warnings.description: structured assembly warnings — wire the assembly node's `warnings` output.

name: build_assembly_report

constructCount.description: how many constructs the summary table describes

errorsCsv.description: the errors spreadsheet — upstream's `errors.csv`, or an empty string when the run had none. Faithful to upstream's own 4-header / 3-field mismatch

partsUsed.description: every part name that appears in at least one construct

report.description: the whole report object, including the summary dataframe and the plots decision

stats.description: the Outcome / Number of assemblies table, as `compute_stats` produces it

summaryCsv.description: the constructs spreadsheet, pandas-compatible CRLF CSV — upstream's `constructs.csv`

summaryText.description: the report as plain text, for a run record or a note

warningsCsv.description: the warnings spreadsheet, or an empty string when the run had none
